what: Permian Resources is an oil and gas producer focused entirely on the Delaware basin in West Texas and New Mexico, the most productive part of the Permian. It has grown mainly by buying neighbouring acreage.
customers: Refiners, gas processors and crude buyers, mostly along the US Gulf Coast.
money: Oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids
moat: Contiguous Delaware basin acreage with low drilling costs per barrel and a drilling inventory measured in years, in the best part of the best US basin.
risks: Debt of about $3.2 billion against almost no cash
Shale wells decline quickly, so drilling must continue just to hold production
Growth has depended on acquisitions, which get harder as acreage prices rise
opportunities: Revenue grew about 33% a year over three years as it consolidated acreage
Operating margin of 29% with among the lowest costs per barrel in the basin
Analysts see about 35% upside from current levels
watch: Well costs per lateral foot and free cash flow per share.
